notes: Ludum Dare 43 first-person stealth game The Village Sacrifice (itch: https://bizbud.itch.io/the-village-sacrifice). Complete Unity 2018.2.18f1 project. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE.txt (Copyright 2020 Hayden Donnelly, Peter Prickarz, Eric Goetz; git blob 08715366a8dd0c261d12316a50667ce1f781a99e). Playable scenes enabled in EditorBuildSettings: Assets/Scenes/UI Scenes/MainMenu.unity, GameOver.unity, and Assets/Scenes/Levels/Level02.unity, Level03.unity, Level04.unity; Level01.unity is present but disabled in the build list. Official Unity packages are referenced only in Packages/manifest.json (not vendored): TextMesh Pro 1.2.4, Ads 2.0.8, Analytics 2.0.16, Purchasing 2.0.3, package-manager-ui, and built-in modules. No TextMesh Pro / EmojiOne assets are present in the tree. Upstream tracks images/audio/models via Git LFS; those objects were pulled and stored as regular git blobs, and filter=lfs rules were removed from src/.gitattributes. Official Unity Post Processing Stack v1 is vendored under Assets/PostProcessing (Unity Technologies, BSD-3-Clause) with Christoph Peters bluenoise textures under CC0-1.0; NVIDIA FXAA 3.11 (FXAA.shader, FXAA3.cginc, FxaaComponent.cs, ARR) was omitted; WheelMovecs.FBX was an unresolved uppercase LFS pointer and was omitted with its .meta. Unity Standard Assets Prototyping under Assets/Standard Assets/ was omitted (Unity companion / Asset Store license, not an OSS whitelist license); the only outside reference is the unused disabled scene Assets/Scenes/Prototyping Scenes/Prototyping_01.unity. Assets/Music/Eerie Music 1 (YUJ).wav (md5 ed2022ba0038a73e972d5d55184fb5cd, ~28M, no embedded tags) was omitted under verified_only: the README names Eric Goetz as composer, but the stock-like filename could not be matched to a verified original or whitelist-licensed source. GUID references may remain. Root AIPlanning notes and unused prototyping scenes (except omitted Standard Assets) are retained. No DOTween / Library / Logs / DLL / .DS_Store / .vscode. ~44M src snapshot.
